target_customer: Enterprise finance and accounting teams in Germany, especially SAP, DATEV and Dynamics users
problem: Invoice recording, coding, matching and approval chasing consume accountants' time; Finto automates invoice to pay with AI agents.

founders.name: Jonas Morgner
founders.background_notes: YC page: led go-to-market at TradeLink for 4+ years

founders.name: Linus Boehm
founders.background_notes: YC page: first full-time employee and early tech lead at Tacto

founders.name: Lorenz Neuner
founders.background_notes: YC page: led product at TradeLink for 4+ years

technical_complexity.rationale: Agentic invoice processing with ERP integrations (SAP, Dynamics, DATEV) is standard engineering with hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Deep ERP integration and German compliance workflows raise switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: DATEV offered invoice automation since 2021 and Candis offers AI accounts payable; no acquisition of Finto found.

market_need_then: German e-invoice obligations for B2B recipients began in 2025, per a third-party source, which drives invoice automation demand.

branding.domain_note: Operates at gofinto.com with a go prefix.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand-focused press found; the go prefix domain suggests the exact .com was unavailable.

outcome_analysis: Finto raised a $3.4M seed in July 2026 from Gradient, Lightspeed and YC, about a year after its YC batch, and has named customers such as Arminia Bielefeld. Its founders come from German logistics and procurement SaaS, which fits the market. It remains early with no exit.
notes: VCBacked lists an earlier $500K pre-seed (Sep 2025) and Seedtable lists different founders and 2022 founding; both unverified and not recorded. Dated competitor search found Candis and DATEV with undated pages, so the list is empty. Founder education not found.
